messages:
ara: heads-up — new user following the hello-echo quickstart hit a payment gating weirdness on first call :confused:

ara: steps they did:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"echo-small","input":"hello"}'
```

ara: response was 402 Payment Required, body:
```json
{"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace requires billing setup"}
```

ara: but org shows a card on file in console and invoices exist. anyone seen the trial gating not clearing?

devon: @ara can you paste the org id (obfuscated ok) and the user email? also which region was the call to (us-west/us-east/eu)?

ara: org: org_7Xf...c9, user: new-hire@example.com, region: us-west-2

sam: there was a race a while back where the trial-enrollment flag wasn't flipped after payment webhook if the workspace was created simultaneously by the invite flow. looks similar.

sam: quick repro check — can you call the billing refresh admin endpoint (only infra/billing folks can run) or run the CLI sync? e.g.
```bash
# infra only
redwoodctl billing refresh --org org_7Xf...c9
```

onboarding-bot: New sign-up detected for new-hire@example.com. Workspace org_7Xf...c9 created 2026-03-15 14:02 UTC. Initial plan: trial. Billing status: pending_webhook.

julia: I just deployed a small fix in staging that retries webhook processing on the payment webhook consumer and enqueues billing-sync. Prod rollout scheduled in 30m. If you can, run the CLI sync as a workaround.

devon: alternate workaround: create a service token from console (Settings -> API tokens) and try the call with that token — in a few cases that bypassed the quickstart gating while we reconcile billing.

ara: tried the CLI sync (thanks julia) — output:
```
$ redwoodctl billing refresh --org org_7Xf...c9
Refreshing billing for org_7Xf...c9... done. status -> active
```

ara: retried the original curl and got 200 + echo response :tada:
```json
{"id":"resp_abc123","output":"hello"}
```

ara: marking this resolved for the user, filing a short repro to prod-bugs. tagging @julia to follow up on the webhook retry rollout. thanks all :raised_hands:
